summary: Reserve budget projects carry a GL account, an expected month and a review status, so reserve expenditures come only from planned capital projects (aggregated by GL account for the budget and statements). Adds three nullable/defaulted columns, a foreign key, two checks and an index to reserve_budget_items. Creates no journal entry, budget line or ledger row.

preflight.name: reserve_budget_items exists
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'reserve_budget_items'

preflight.name: account_id not added yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'reserve_budget_items' AND column_name = 'account_id'

expected_changes: reserve_budget_items gains account_id (FK chart_of_accounts, RESTRICT), planned_month (1-12) and review_status ('planned' | 'needs_review', default 'planned').

verify.name: three columns exist
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'reserve_budget_items' AND column_name IN ('account_id', 'planned_month', 'review_status')

verify.name: existing rows default to planned
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM reserve_budget_items WHERE review_status <> 'planned'
